title: 每 N 步保存一次

standard.summary: 每隔 N 个优化步保存一次 LoRA checkpoint。0 = 禁用按步保存，此时 save_every_n_epochs 必须大于 0。
standard.effect: 设为 100 → 每 100 步保存一次，可以从中间步骤的 checkpoint 选择最佳版本。与 save_every_n_epochs 不能同时为 0：都为 0 时中途中断拿不到任何权重，配置校验会拒绝。
standard.whenToUse: 长训练（>300步）推荐每 50~100 步保存一次，方便对比不同步数的效果找到最优点。
standard.avoidWhen: 保存频率过高（如每 10 步）会占用大量磁盘空间，每个 LoRA 文件约 60~200MB。

standard_en.summary: How many optimisation steps apart a LoRA checkpoint is saved. 0 = step-based saving disabled, in which case save_every_n_epochs must be greater than 0.
standard_en.effect: Set to 100 -> a save every 100 steps, so you can pick the best version from the intermediate checkpoints. It cannot be 0 at the same time as save_every_n_epochs: with both at 0 an interruption leaves you no weights, and configuration validation rejects it.
standard_en.whenToUse: Saving every 50~100 steps is recommended on a long run (>300 steps), which makes it easy to compare step counts and find the sweet spot.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too high a frequency (every 10 steps, say) eats a lot of disk space, at roughly 60~200MB per LoRA file.

advanced.principle: 每 N 步调用 save_model()，写出当前 LoRA state_dict（不含优化器状态）。若同时开启 EMA，同时保存 EMA 权重副本。
advanced.tradeoffs: 频繁保存 = 更多选择但更多磁盘空间；不频繁 = 省空间但可能错过最优步数。

advanced_en.principle: Every N steps it calls save_model(), writing out the current LoRA state_dict (without optimizer state). If EMA is also enabled, an EMA weight copy is saved at the same time.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Frequent saving = more choices but more disk space; infrequent saving = less space but you may miss the optimal step.
